TITLE: Internal Systems and Key Collaborators at Zastama Industries  

Zastama Industries is currently advancing several core internal systems and initiatives designed to support strategic goals and improve operational efficiency. This page outlines the current status of the Trebrula Beacon and the Lagemett Ledger, along with the personnel and vendor teams working on these projects.  

---

### The Trebrula Beacon  

The Trebrula Beacon is a critical internal tool currently in the pre-launch phase. It is offered exclusively in the internal-only tier and is not available for external use. With about 8,200 active users across departments, the system is being used to test workflows and gather feedback ahead of its scheduled launch in Q1 FY27.  

The Trebrula Beacon is designed to streamline internal communication and data sharing, allowing for more efficient cross-functional collaboration. The system is being used to track internal projects, manage resources, and support internal reporting.  

Currently, the project team is focused on finalizing key features, improving user experience, and ensuring system stability. With the launch date approaching, additional training materials and support documentation are being developed to facilitate a smooth rollout across all departments.  

---

### Project Leadership and Management  

Desgua Stebela plays a central role in managing the development and implementation of internal systems and reports to Berruan Zenresan. Desgua Stebela is responsible for tracking project timelines, coordinating between teams, and ensuring that strategic goals are met on schedule. This structured reporting relationship allows for clear decision-making and accountability across the organization.  

Pivoine Geltoett is currently leading the development of demand forecasting models that will support internal planning and resource allocation. These models are being designed to improve accuracy in predicting usage and demand for tools like the Trebrula Beacon. Pivoine Geltoett works closely with other teams to ensure that these models are integrated into broader operational planning processes.  

Givien Mubren is a member of the Gelgos Infrastructure Team, which is responsible for maintaining and improving the technical systems that support Zastama Industries’ internal tools. Givien Mubren’s contributions have been vital to the performance and scalability of the Trebrula Beacon and the Lagemett Ledger. The Gelgos Infrastructure Team continues to focus on optimizing system performance and ensuring reliability across all internal platforms.  

---

### The Lagemett Ledger and Vendor Contributions  

The Lagemett Ledger is a key internal system used for financial and operational tracking. It is supported by components supplied by two primary vendors: Misginine Systems and Dilhas Consulting.  

Misginine Systems provides essential infrastructure components that are integrated into the Lagemett Ledger. These components include data processing modules and security frameworks that ensure the system’s accuracy and reliability. Misginine Systems works in close partnership with internal teams to ensure that updates are implemented smoothly and that technical issues are resolved promptly.  

Dilhas Consulting also plays a key role in the Lagemett Ledger’s development and has a 24-month master services agreement in place with Zastama Industries. Under this agreement, Dilhas Consulting is responsible for developing custom modules and optimizing system performance. The collaboration has enabled the Lagemett Ledger to evolve into a more robust and scalable tool.  

Both Misginine Systems and Dilhas Consulting are essential partners in maintaining and enhancing the Lagemett Ledger. Internal teams meet regularly with vendor representatives to review progress, set priorities, and ensure that the system continues to meet the needs of the organization.  

---

### Upcoming Activities and Collaboration  

With the Trebrula Beacon set for launch in Q1 FY27, the project team is finalizing testing, refining features, and preparing training materials. The feedback from the 8,200 active users has been instrumental in shaping the final version of the system. Cross-functional teams are working together to ensure that all departments are ready to adopt the tool upon its release.  

For the Lagemett Ledger, the focus remains on integrating components from Misginine Systems and Dilhas Consulting to improve system performance and expand functionality. The Gelgos Infrastructure Team, including Givien Mubren, is monitoring system performance and supporting ongoing technical improvements.  

Pivoine Geltoett will continue to refine demand forecasting models to support better planning for internal tools and future initiatives. These models will provide valuable insights into resource allocation and system usage across departments.  

Desgua Stebela and Berruan Zenresan are working to ensure that all internal projects remain aligned with strategic priorities and are delivered on schedule. Regular coordination and communication between teams are key to maintaining progress and addressing any challenges that arise.  

All employees are encouraged to stay informed about these initiatives and to reach out to their managers or relevant team leads with any questions or feedback. Regular updates will continue to be posted in this wiki as the projects develop.  

---

Zastama Industries is committed to strengthening its internal systems and processes to support long-term growth and efficiency. The continued progress of the Trebrula Beacon, the Lagemett Ledger, and the teams and vendors involved in these projects will be central to achieving these goals.
